blocks.html:

What is TAK and what does ATAK allow you to accomplish

slides.title: What is TAK
slides.html:
• Team Awareness Kit (civ) / Tactical Assault Kit (mil)
  • Geospatial situational-awareness tool
  • Widely used by Nato Militaries and Law Enforce Agencies / Emergency Response Organizations

slides.title: What is ATAK
slides.html:
• Android TAK Application
  • The main application for TAK

slides.title: ATAK Blueforce
slides.html:
• Blueforce Tracking
  • Seeing where you are and where your teammates are on map
  • Allows leaders to make better decision with proper real time information

slides.title: ATAK Chat
slides.html:
• Message other users and groups via TAK
  • Send text, pictures, files and datapackages

slides.title: ATAK Markers
slides.html:
• Place markers to map (Enemies, Friendlies, Other: Hospitals, Supply Points, etc)
  • Send the markers to users and groups

slides.title: ATAK Data Sync
slides.html:
• Synchronize chat, map markers, files between users and server
  • Data is shown while offline, changes can be made and automatically updated when online

slides.title: ATAK Planning
slides.html:
• Plans for i.e. unit placements, movements and responsibility ares can be drawn
  • Plans can be prepared before hand and shared to users when needed
